model: Predict the actual worker command chosen by a frozen v6 policy including search. Opposing bases retain frozen priors.
fog: Observer fog and own replay actions on every turn; frozen neural router evaluated in contiguous windows. Rival action inferred only next turn from surviving movements for gate.
sampling: Operational baseline and deployed residual use frozen rollout temperature .4; a temperature-only model and a three-specialist-logit model also fitted to identical training data.
